title: Running an app on iMicrobe
author: Alise J Ponsero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.r9jd94n

steps.title: Select datasets for analysis
steps.instruction: Add desired datasets to your personal cart using the 'Add to cart' button; these can be managed via the Cart icon on the top right of the screen.

steps.title: Launch the iMicrobe app
steps.instruction: Access the desired iMicrobe app through the App search interface by selecting 'App' from the 'Tool' dropdown menu.

steps.title: Provide input data
steps.instruction: Select one of the three available input methods to provide data for the analysis.

substeps.instruction: To use the Cart: Select 'Cart' in the Input field, choose the required files from the discussion window, and confirm.
To use the Datastore: Select 'Datastore' in the Input field, browse the Cyverse datastore window, select the required files, and confirm.
To use an FTP URL: Paste the FTP addresses into the input field, separating multiple addresses with semi-colons.

steps.title: Execute the app
steps.instruction: Complete the app parameters and run the app.
